Context: 12. Assistance to Government servants in legal proceedings

- (vi) Cases filed against the Government servant by another Government servant in respect of matters connected with the farmer's official position I duties.Same as at Item (ii) above. This will not apply if he is impleaded as co-respondent in suits against the Government in regard to conditions of service, seniority, etc. - GIDs (1), (2), Rule 19 and Appendix-I.
